content:
maya: quick heads-up — onboarded a new 14B variant (magnet-14b-lite, int4) into the canary pool and hit weird divergence after ~16k tokens in a longprefill test. not catastrophic but outputs drift from baseline.
eli: can you paste the minimal repro or logs? which job + run id?
maya: run id `onboard-3187-mg14b-quant-check`. Repro script: `./tests/longprefill_repro.sh --model magnet-14b-lite --quant int4 --seq-len 20000 --dump-kv`
ops-bot: deploy notice: Canary node pool c-3 started job onboard-3187-mg14b-quant-check at 2026-03-21T10:12:30Z
samir: saw similar before — usually a mismatch between how we apply the rotary scaling at prefill vs streaming. baseline runs with fp16 kept coherence.
nina: what does the dump-kv show? any posindex wrap or off-by-one?
maya: kv dump attached (s3://redwood-temp/onboard/3187/kvdump.tar.gz) — quick grep showed a scale factor toggle: some layers have scale ~1.0, others ~0.9992 — looks tiny but accumulates across long context.
eli: tiny multiplicative drift across 128 layers * 16k tokens is enough. Could be quant kernel applying rotary scale again during dequant/convert.
samir: hypothesis: int4 dequant path multiplies by rotary_scale during load and kernel also does it; double-application. Can we run with env ROTARY_SCALE_DEBUG=1 to trace scaler calls?
maya: running now with ROTARY_SCALE_DEBUG and a smaller seq (8k) to capture traces. will post logs.
ops-bot: job onboard-3187-mg14b-quant-check (trace) started on canary-2
nina: also try pinning SEQ_TILE=1024 vs 2048 — if tiling boundary causes partial application, we might see step-like jumps in scale.
eli: good call. can you also run a nondeterministic check: same prompt but stream vs prefilled context to see if priming path differs?
maya: did two quick runs: (1) prefill-only -> stable up to 24k (fp16), (2) prefill+stream int4 -> drift at 16k. attaching trimmed trace lines:
```
[rotary] layer=45 apply_rotary(scale=0.9992) called_from=dequant_path
[rotary] layer=45 apply_rotary(scale=0.9992) called_from=kernel_mul
[rotary] cumulative_scale=0.9984 at token=8000
```
eli: yeah that shows double-call. Samir, can you add a guard so kernel checks a flag like SKIP_ROTARY_ON_DEQUANT? quick patch in qkernel?
samir: will try a hotfix: set SKIP_ROTARY_ON_DEQUANT in runtime; patch and run on canary. if green we can schedule proper fix in quant-kernel branch.
maya: hotfix rolling to canary now.
ops-bot: rolling update: canary-2 updated with SKIP_ROTARY_ON_DEQUANT=1 (image rwd/serve:canary-20260321-a)
samir: preliminary results: int4 prefill+stream no longer diverging in 10k run. will run longer 30k overnight.
nina: awesome. also add a unit test that simulates dequant + kernel path and asserts rotary applied exactly once.
eli: and let's add a tiny eval in the onboarding harness that compares running perplexity on longprefill vs fp16 baseline to catch regressions automatically.
maya: agree. filing a follow-up PR with test + doc note on quant path: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/4239
samir: marking root cause = double-application of rotary scale in quant dequant + kernel. assignment: samir (fix), maya (regression test + onboard harness), eli (eval integration).
maya: thanks all — will keep thread updates. :sparkles:
